text:
mara: quick ask — weekend experiment idea: avoid the usual morning budget spike by staggering dayparts, run a control vs creative group, and route webinar signups straight to the inbound SDR queue. low-risk, short run (48h). thoughts?

sam: @mara can do. we should set a hard morning cap (<=35% daily) and a soft evening bump. i can update pacing rules and set a control adset. need exact caps and which adsets are control. :white_check_mark:

diego: i'm for this. primary metric = cost per SQL (track via utm + webhook). secondary = landing conversion rate. control group = current top-performing creative, experiment = 3 new headlines + fresh hero image. want a tiny holdout (10%) for baseline.

olivia: throwing in three headline ideas (short):
- "Ship ML features — without infra headaches"
- "Predictable LLM inference for production"
- "Serve models faster, cheaper, reliably"
I'll make 3 variants of the hero (prod screenshot, bench chart, customer quote).

jen: landing page note — if you route to webinar flow, use query param `?source=weekend_test` so we can split in GA and in the CRM. also swap CTA to "request a demo" for the experiment.

sam: plan to implement this evening. proposed config (will apply to campaign-level pacing):
```json
{
  "campaign_id": "camp_2026_weekend_test",
  "daily_budget": 1200,
  "daypart_caps": {"morning": 0.35, "midday": 0.30, "evening": 0.35},
  "control_pct": 0.10,
  "creative_variants": 3
}
```
I'll tag the control adset `control-v1` and experiment adsets `exp-a/b/c`. @diego i need the final UTM values you'll use.

marketing-bot: Campaign camp_2026_weekend_test scheduled for 2026-03-21 20:00 UTC. Notification will be sent at deploy.

mara: perfect — @sam please set morning cap and routing. @olivia aim to drop creatives by 18:00 PT. @jen confirm GA & CRM param mapping by EOD. i want a quick dashboard card for SQLs and landing conversion so we can stop early if CPA spikes. :rocket:
